description: This file defines various template metaprogramming utilities and type traits within the WPEFramework namespace, including pick, func_traits, enable_if, is_same, inherits, and macros for checking member and static member availability.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select a type from a parameter pack based on an index.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract function traits such as return type, class type, and argument types from various callable types.

classes.name: same_or_inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types are the same or one inherits from the other.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed.

classes.name: IS_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to check if a member function exists with a specific signature.

classes.name: IS_MEMBER_AVAILABLE_INHERITANCE_TREE
classes.description: Macro to check if a member function exists in the inheritance tree with a specific signature.

classes.name: IS_STATIC_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to check if a static member function exists with a specific signature.

classes.name: IS_TEMPLATE_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to check if a template member function exists with a specific signature.
